title: Sentinel Real Fraud Dataset Feature Mapping
description: Mapping from raw credit card transaction columns to Sentinel detection feature space

source_columns.Time: Elapsed seconds from dataset origin across 48-hour window
source_columns.V1_to_V28: 28 PCA-derived anonymized latent components representing cardholder/device/merchant signals

engineered_features.amount_scaled: Z-score normalized Amount using training set mean (88.1763) and std (250.7226)
engineered_features.amount_log1p: Natural log transformation log(1 + Amount) handling heavy-tailed amounts
engineered_features.time_sin: Continuous cyclic sine representation: sin(2 * pi * hour / 24)
engineered_features.time_cos: Continuous cyclic cosine representation: cos(2 * pi * hour / 24)
engineered_features.V1_to_V28: 28 numerical continuous PCA features with missing value imputation via training medians

target_variable.storage: Preserved strictly as separate target vector (y_train, y_held_out)

leakage_safeguards: Fitted parameters computed strictly from train.csv
Held-out set never accessed during fit()
Zero index overlap between train and held-out partitions
Exact frozen parameters serialized for future model evaluation
